usedFor: Timeero tracks time and mileage, and Calendly makes a booking link with “Create Scheduling Link” when “Job Created” happens.

bestTemplate.name: “Schedule Created” in Timeero, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new schedule in Timeero can produce a booking link in Calendly.

watchOut: Delete triggers like “User Deleted” fire too, so a link can be created for a record already gone.
